bot-ai-visualization-failed: Could not open the visualization. Try again later.
bot-ai-empty: The assistant has nothing to add.
bot-ai-file-not-ready: The file is still being processed or could not be read. Please send it again in a minute.
bot-ai-new-chat: Starting a new conversation. Write your question.
bot-ai-no-assistant: The assistant is available to students and administrators. Use the menu for your lessons and journal.
bot-error-generic: Something went wrong while handling your request. The team has been told.
bot-feedback-ask-area: Which part of the platform is it about?
bot-feedback-ask-description: Describe it. What happened, or what would help you? Up to {limit} characters.
bot-feedback-ask-files: Send up to {limit} files (photos, documents or videos, 20 MB each) if they help. Press Done when you are finished, or Skip.
bot-feedback-ask-kind: What is it? Pick a kind of report.
bot-feedback-ask-title: Write a short title (up to {limit} characters).
bot-feedback-attach-hint: Send a photo, a document or a video, or press Done or Skip.
bot-feedback-attached: Attached {count} of {limit}. Send another file, or press Done.
bot-feedback-bad-description: The description must be 1 to {limit} characters. Try again.
bot-feedback-bad-title: The title must be 1 to {limit} characters. Try again.
bot-feedback-file-failed: The file could not be processed. Send it again, or press Done.
bot-feedback-rate-limited: You have sent the maximum number of reports for today (10). Please try again tomorrow.
bot-feedback-sent: Thank you. Your report has been sent.
bot-feedback-summary: Check your report Kind: {kind} Area: {area} Title: {title} {description} Files: {files} Send it?
bot-feedback-text-only: Please send text here, or press Cancel.
bot-feedback-too-many-files: You can attach up to {limit} files. Press Done to continue.
bot-feedback-use-buttons: Please use the buttons above, or press Cancel.
bot-guest-choice: Welcome to International House Tashkent! Who are you?
bot-guest-error: Sorry, I could not answer right now. Please try again later.
bot-guest-limit: You have asked many questions. Please try again later.
bot-guest-busy: The assistant is busy right now. Please try again later.
bot-guest-no-answer: Sorry, I have no answer to that. Please contact the lyceum.
bot-help: IHT bot Use the buttons below or the commands /today, /marks, /homework, /mail and /settings. /cancel stops any step you started.
bot-hint-in-state: I am waiting for your answer to the current step. Send it, or press Cancel.
bot-hint-unexpected: I did not expect that message. Choose a section:
bot-homework-ask: Send the homework as a text message.
bot-homework-cancelled: Cancelled. The homework was not saved.
bot-homework-text-only: Please send the homework as text.
bot-homework-too-long: That is too long. Send up to {limit} characters.
bot-journal-hint: Tap a student to put a temporary mark.
bot-journal-roster-changed: The class list has changed; choose the student again.
bot-lesson-none: No lessons in the coming days.
bot-linked-as: Logged in as {login}. Choose a section:
bot-linked-elsewhere: Telegram account {who} was linked to your IHT account. If it was not you, open the security settings.
bot-login-welcome: Welcome to IHT. Press Log in to sign in or to register.
bot-logout-confirm: Log out of this Telegram account? Login codes and notifications will stop coming here.
bot-mail-ask-body: Send the text of the email. Formatting is kept.
bot-mail-ask-note: Send a note to put above the forwarded email, or press Skip.
bot-mail-attachment-skipped: 📎 {name} (not sent: too large or not allowed)
bot-mail-bad-address: That is not a valid email address. Send one or more addresses separated by commas.
bot-mail-bad-subject: Send a subject of up to {limit} characters.
bot-mail-purged: The full email was deleted after 30 days.
bot-marks-none: No marks in the last 7 days.
bot-not-me-otp: If you did not ask for this code, change your password and check your sessions in the security settings.
bot-not-me-tg: If you did not link this Telegram account, remove it in the security settings.
bot-otp-cancelled: The reset was cancelled. Codes keep coming to your Telegram accounts.
bot-otp-reset: A reset of OTP delivery was requested. Telegram codes will stop coming to your accounts on {when}. If it was not you, cancel it now.
bot-prompt-ask-homework: Homework: not set yet. Add it?
bot-prompt-conflict: Attendance was changed by someone else. Review the list and submit again.
bot-prompt-expired: This prompt has expired. Use the staff portal.
bot-prompt-hint: Tap the students who are absent (✗). Absent now: {absent}.
bot-prompt-roster-cut: {count} more students are not shown. Use the staff portal.
bot-resource-ask: Send a file (up to 20 MB) or a link.
bot-resource-pick: Add this to a lesson? Choose the lesson and the type.
bot-resource-too-large: This file is larger than 20 MB, so the bot cannot take it. Upload it in the staff portal.
bot-set-drops: Alert when GPA or a semester mark drops
bot-set-lead: Send lesson links before the lesson starts
bot-set-mark-below: Alert when a mark is below
bot-set-semester-below: Alert when a semester mark is below
bot-settings-marks: Which marks should I send you?
bot-settings-subjects: Choose the subjects for mark notifications. All are on by default.
bot-settings-thresholds: Choose when I should alert you. Everything is off by default.
bot-stale-button: This button is out of date. Open the menu.
bot-topic-ask: Send the topic of the lesson.
bot-topic-too-long: Send a topic of up to {limit} characters.
bot-work-off-ask-text: Send the work-off task as a text message.
bot-work-off-no-templates: You have no work-off templates yet. Add them in the staff portal settings, or use Add text.
bot-work-off-pick: Choose the work-off task for the absent students:
bot-work-off-too-long: Send a text of up to {limit} characters.
bot-workoffs-student-empty: You have no open work-off tasks.
bot-workoffs-student-more: {count} more are not shown. Open the app.
bot-workoffs-teacher-hint: Tap a work-off to mark it as done.
